title: Renewable engineering domain contracts; no default project scenario

Jurisdiction.description: Geographic/legal jurisdiction only. Never an electrical operating mode.

OperatingMode.description: System operating condition. Never a US state or an evidence disposition.

EnclosureQualification.description: An enclosure designation does not prove coastal or chemical suitability.

ElectricalConstraint.description: 480 V alone does not establish wye/delta, line-neutral voltage, neutral or grounding.

RedundancyClaim.description: A source count or mains/BESS/generator hierarchy is not itself N+k proof.

CalculationRequirement.description: Input/output contract only; no project calculation is performed by this ontology.

RacewaySpecification.description: Physical containment system specification; not an electrical net or conductor-size calculation.

RacewayRouteAnnotation.description: Physical route graphics/anchors cannot be used as electrical terminals.

PVSourceSpecification.description: PV data/input contract only. Counts and rated-condition data are unresolved until actual project data is provided.

PVShutdownRequirement.description: Selected applicability, approach, compatible equipment, boundary and verification are separately evidenced. Symbol presence does not establish rapid shutdown compliance.

ControlFunctionSpecification.description: A control role is distinct from power conversion and from a verified approved system configuration.

SensorSpecification.description: A logical sense port does not specify physical instrument-transformer secondary wiring or rating.

ProtectionSpecification.description: Trip/frame, interrupting rating, withstand and assembly SCCR are different input/evidence fields; no rating is calculated.

DistributionAssemblySpecification.description: Multiple drawing ports do not prove an internal common bus or select an interconnection method.

GroundingBondingSpecification.description: Grounded/neutral conductors, equipment grounding and electrode paths have distinct roles. No default neutral-ground bond or electrode dimensions.

TransferSpecification.description: Transition category is distinct from observed switch position. Closed transition is not utility authorization or an uninterrupted-power claim.

GeneratorSpecification.description: Application/duty and regulatory classification do not establish running condition, fuel autonomy or backup availability.

AvailabilityDependency.description: A reusable dependency contract for later failure-case review; it neither instantiates redundancy nor proves independent availability.

PhysicalCoordinateFrame.description: Physical model, paper layout and NTS glyph frames are distinct.

FootprintDefinition.description: Physical footprint and equipment identity are independent from the symbolic SLD occurrence.

MountingInterface.description: A mounting preview does not establish connection capacity, anchorage design or a verified load path.

SpatialEnvelopeRequirement.description: Working space, service clearance, fire separation and movement/access envelopes are independently sourced requirements.

EnvironmentalExposureRecord.description: Physical hazard/exposure evidence is distinct from geographic or coastal permitting jurisdiction.

AuthorityScope.description: An authority territory/topic is distinct from operating mode and does not itself grant a permit.

RuleApplicability.description: Applicability is a separate decision from evidence review status; a guidance source is not an adopted rule.

ComplianceNoteInstance.description: A reusable note is not an issued project assertion. Actual applicability and resolved references must be checked.

ExternalAuthorizationRecord.description: Authority decisions are distinct milestones from professional review and from one another.

SheetDefinition.description: A drawing issue stage is distinct from professional execution, AHJ acceptance and utility authorization.

DrawingOccurrence.description: One model subject can have many schematic/physical occurrences; a screen coordinate never supplies a physical distance.

ScheduleContract.description: A schedule layout supplies no project rows, engineering values or verified code mappings.

AnnotationPlacement.description: Annotation offsets are drafting placement, not electrical/fire clearance or conductor topology.
